in_hebrew.name: עזליה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name 'Azelea' is derived from the Hebrew roots 'azal' meaning 'help' or 'assist' and 'el' meaning 'God'. It can be interpreted as 'God is my helper' or 'God has helped me'. This name is not found in the Bible but can be used as a meaningful name for a child.
